_comment: Calibration gradient check on a 14-day window from 1993-01, nothing frozen, central differences at several steps in log κ: 1165329 (h = 0.05) gave adjoint / central difference ratios 1.22 (κ_skew) and 1.60 (κ_symmetric). Converging to the adjoint as h shrinks means a rough misfit; staying put means an inexact adjoint.
